name: Marshalling cable-screen earth interface
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Identifies the screen earthing connection specified for the assigned yard-to-panel control cable.
description: Identifies the screen earthing connection specified for the assigned yard-to-panel control cable. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Control cable screen” at the input and “Assigned screen earth point” at the output. Screen strategy depends on interference and protection design.
